narrative: Buyers are committing money faster than the chain can ship, and the squeeze has moved from packaging to stacked memory, with NVIDIA trimming the memory on its top Rubin Ultra part so a fixed memory pool fills more chips. The question that decides the next rating change is whether memory makers add capacity through 2027 quickly enough to keep pace, and this read departs from the common view that packaging still sets the ceiling, because packaging supply is closing its gap while memory is being rationed. Watch memory contract prices and the memory specification of the next accelerator generation, since a second round of shrinking memory per chip would show the ceiling falling further.

categoryStatus.reason: Orders and vendor margins stay very strong, so what limits shipments is physical: stacked-memory supply is sold out into 2027 and vendors are already trimming memory per chip to stretch it, even as packaging capacity catches up.
